notes.title: New Game Announcement – Infinite Cards!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! [/p][p]I’m excited to share that my next game, [b]Infinite Cards[/b], is now live on Steam. You can wishlist it right now! [/p][p]It’s a roguelike deckbuilder with infinite unique cards, deep strategy, and fully flexible deck building. Wishlist here: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3833300/Infinite_Cards/"][/dynamiclink]If you’ve enjoyed Dungeon Wizards or Ogo, there’s a good chance you’ll like this one too. It’s packed with strategic choices and fun combos.[/p][p][/p][h1]Discord Server![/h1][p]Also, I’ve launched a Tubby Turtle Studios Discord Server! There you’ll find updates on Infinite Cards, plus places to chat about Dungeon Wizards, Ogo, and all upcoming games.[/p][p][/p][p]Join the Discord here: [url="https://discord.gg/vhxWQVKsgv"]https://discord.gg/vhxWQVKsgv[/url][/p][p] [/p][p]Thanks so much for playing and supporting my games, it really means a lot! [/p][p]Tubby Turtle[/p]
